# Paletton

> Professional color scheme designer and palette generator using RYB color theory for web, UI, and graphic design projects.

Paletton (formerly Color Scheme Designer 3) is a comprehensive color palette tool that helps designers create harmonious color combinations using the RYB color wheel. It supports multiple export formats including HTML, CSS, LESS, XML, PNG, Photoshop ACO, and Gimp GPL, with built-in color blindness simulation and WCAG accessibility checking.

## Key Topics

- Color scheme generation
- RYB color wheel
- Color harmony theory
- Monochromatic palettes
- Complementary colors
- Triadic color schemes
- Color blindness simulation
- WCAG accessibility
- HTML/CSS export
- Photoshop ACO format
- Gimp GPL format
- UI design colors
- Web design palettes
- Color contrast checking
- Colorpedia integration

## Color Scheme Tools

- [Paletton - The Color Scheme Designer](https://paletton.com/): Main color scheme designer tool using RYB color wheel for creating harmonious palettes for web and UI design with export options for HTML, CSS, LESS, XML, PNG, Photoshop ACO, and Gimp GPL formats
